survey: The image is a beach ball sitting on wavy sand, with dunes behind it, seen from slightly above. Six panels (red, white, blue, white, green, white) run as curved lines from the purple cap down to a pole underneath, out of sight. They curve around the sphere as seams on a ball should, and get narrower toward the cap and toward the outline of the ball. The purple cap sits on the upper front of the sphere, a little more than halfway from the centre to the top edge. It is drawn as an ellipse about 0.8 times as tall as it is wide, which matches a surface tilted about 35° away from the viewer at that spot. The ball sinks slightly into the sand. Its shadow falls to the lower right on the ground, and the ground plane is seen from the same high angle as the ball.
